badge_description: Required training for all NJIT researchers who handle export-controlled materials. This badge verifies completion of mandatory compliance requirements.
intended_audience: NJIT faculty and staff conducting research
earning_criteria_text: Attend the full Export Control compliance training session. This training is mandatory to apply for access to export-controlled materials. Students must show up to the training.
